question: Giá trị đơn trung bình là bao nhiêu?
gold_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(i.price + i.freight_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS aov
FROM mart.fct_order_items AS i
JOIN mart.fct_orders AS o
  ON o.order_id = i.order_id
WHERE
  o.order_status = 'delivered'

question: Giá trị đơn trung bình năm 2017
gold_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(i.price + i.freight_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS aov
FROM mart.fct_order_items AS i
JOIN mart.fct_orders AS o
  ON o.order_id = i.order_id
WHERE
  o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND (
    o.purchased_at >= '2017-01-01' AND o.purchased_at < '2018-01-01'

question: gia tri don trung binh theo bang quy 1/2018
gold_sql:
SELECT
  o.customer_state AS customer_state,
  SUM(i.price + i.freight_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS aov
FROM mart.fct_order_items AS i
JOIN mart.fct_orders AS o
  ON o.order_id = i.order_id
WHERE
  o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND (
    o.purchased_at >= '2018-01-01' AND o.purchased_at < '2018-04-01'
  )
GROUP BY
  o.customer_state
ORDER BY
  aov DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 30

question: Giá trị đơn trung bình theo loại thanh toán năm 2017
gold_sql:
SELECT
  p.payment_type AS payment_type,
  SUM(i.price + i.freight_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS aov
FROM mart.fct_order_items AS i
JOIN mart.fct_orders AS o
  ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN mart.fct_payments AS p
  ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE
  (
    o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND (
      o.purchased_at >= '2017-01-01' AND o.purchased_at < '2018-01-01'
    )
  )
  AND p.payment_sequential = 1
GROUP BY
  p.payment_type
ORDER BY
  aov DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 30

question: Tỉ lệ phí vận chuyển theo loại thanh toán năm 2018
gold_sql:
SELECT
  p.payment_type AS payment_type,
  SUM(i.freight_value) / SUM(i.price) AS freight_ratio
FROM mart.fct_order_items AS i
JOIN mart.fct_orders AS o
  ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN mart.fct_payments AS p
  ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE
  (
    o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND (
      o.purchased_at >= '2018-01-01' AND o.purchased_at < '2019-01-01'
    )
  )

GROUP BY
  p.payment_type
ORDER BY
  freight_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
